text: 特斯拉降价再度引发市场对“车市价格战”的猜测。9月7日，特斯拉中国宣布推出限时现车激励，9月30日前下单提车，Model3全系现车现金激励5000元，Model Y全系现车现金激励1万元，可叠加5年0息等政策。叠加权益后车型起售价下探，官方称当前Model 3/Y处于改款后价格低位，也是特斯拉组合福利政策最为丰富的阶段。
text_en: Tesla's price cut has again sparked market speculation over a 'car market price war.' On September 7, Tesla China announced limited-time incentives for existing vehicles: orders placed and vehicles delivered before September 30 receive 5,000 yuan cash incentives for all Model 3 existing vehicles and 10,000 yuan for all Model Y existing vehicles, stackable with policies like 0% interest over 5 years. After incorporating the incentives, starting prices drop, with the company saying Model 3/Y are currently at post-facelift price lows and Tesla's combined benefit policies are at their richest stage.
